macros.name: clastwd
macros.doc: Save the width of the previous marker and provide center alignment.

macros.name: defspbstyle
macros.doc: The command \defspbstyle can be used to define the style mathsp* and mathsb* to change the format of the math superscripts and subscripts.

macros.name: fnmarkfont
macros.doc: You can format the footer markers by redefining the \fnmarkfont command.

macros.name: llastwd
macros.doc: Save the width of the previous marker and provide left alignment.

macros.name: maxwd
macros.doc: Save the maximum width of superscript and subscript in the \supersub command.

macros.name: spbset
macros.doc: spbmark uses the \spbset command to control the global default format of superscripts and subscripts.

macros.name: spbshortkv
macros.doc: Converts any existing key-value pair to a shorthand option.

macros.name: sub
macros.doc: This is a subscript output command.

macros.name: subwd
macros.doc: Save the width of the subscript in the \supersub command.

macros.name: super
macros.doc: This is a superscript output command.

macros.name: supersub
macros.doc: This is a command that outputs both superscript and subscript at the same time.

macros.name: superwd
macros.doc: Save the width of the superscript in the \supersub command.
